summary: Round-1 MEDIUM finding (persist-before-send ordering not mutation-proof) is fixed. tests/test_integration.py::TestDedupReviewButtons::test_flag_on_e014_send_includes_review_keyboard now installs a side_effect probe on the send_admin_notification mock that, AT CALL TIME, extracts the token from reply_markup's dd:c:<token> and asserts get_review_token_link(token) already resolves to the flagged link, guarded by a probe_hits count so the in-call assertion can't go vacuous. I independently re-ran the same mutation as round 1 (moved pending_repo.put_review_token to AFTER send_admin_notification in news_bot.py) and confirmed the test now FAILS (AssertionError: 0 != 1, with the underlying probe assertion 'token not persisted BEFORE send_admin_notification' visible in the caught-and-logged E014 error) — then restored the original file (git diff news_bot.py clean) and reran to confirm green. Only tests/test_integration.py changed in this commit; news_bot.py is untouched, matching the coordinator's note that production ordering was already correct. All other round-1 findings (E015-mis-attach litmus, class-reuse-trick cleanliness, flag-default env-parsing bypass) were informational/non-blocking and remain valid observations, not defects — no action needed on those to approve.
